(a) Since you enjoy urban photography at night, you might love taking evening walks through the city to capture interesting lighting and architecture. You could bring a small camera or even use your phone, experimenting with exposure times to create moody, atmospheric shots.
(b) Since you enjoy sipping espresso at small cafés, you might love finding a quiet outdoor café with a good view and spending the evening sketching or people-watching. You could combine it with a gentle walk through a scenic part of town afterward.

(d) You might enjoy bringing a cozy blanket to a quiet park or beach to relax and unwind in the evening. Pair it with a warm drink and maybe some light music or a good book to make the experience even more peaceful.
